name: Deterministic Audio Rights, Pricing and Licensing Matrix
activation_rule: Apply to every eligible phone-catalog package; assign complete non-exclusive pricing/license metadata and explicit work-level evidence states instead of leaving avoidable unset fields.
maintenance_rule: Non-exclusive is default; exclusive licensing starts at USD 100000 and requires a separately scoped written agreement. Never manufacture authorship, split, sample, AI-plan, contributor or chain-of-title evidence.
